Notes:
- Applications with incomplete documents shall not be processed or evaluated.
- Applications submitted before the publication and after the deadline indicated in the publication of

     vacant positions posted in the CSC website shall no longer be entertained.
- The specific position applied for including the item and place of assignment must be indicated in the

     application letter. Without such specifications, the application shall be disregarded.
- All interested and qualified applicants are encouraged to apply. This includes Persons with Disability

     (PWD) and members of the indigenous communities, irrespective of sexual orientation, civil status,
     religion and political affiliation. The City Government of Legazpi does not discriminate in the selection
     of employees based on the aforementioned pursuant to Equal Opportunities for Employment
     Principle (EOP).

How to send feedback?  FEEDBACK AND COMPLAINTS MECHANISM

                                               Answer the Feedback Form located in the Frontline Desk of the
                                               CHRMO, then place it inside the drop box or personally hand it
                                               over to the Officer of the Day (OD).

                            CHRMO Contact Numbers:
                            chrmo.leg@legazpi,gov.ph
                            chrmo.legazpicity@gmail.com

How feedback is processed?  The L&D Division verifies the nature of the queries and
How to file complaint?      feedback within one (1) working day. The same shall be
                            referred to the concerned Division. Upon receipt of reply from
                            the concerned Division, the Client will be informed via email,
                            text or phone call.

                            For follow-ups or inquiries, the contact information are as
                            follows:
                            chrmo.leg@legazpi,gov.ph
                            chrmo.legazpicity@gmail.com

                            (0929 494-6681)

                                   or via e-mail:

                                       - Full name, address and contact information of the

                                       - Narrative of the Complaint
                                       - Evidences
                                       - Name of the Person being Complained

How complaints are processed?      All complaints received against the CHRMO will be processed
                                   by the L&D Division.
Contact Information of CITY HUMAN
RESOURCE MANAGEMENT OFFICE         The L&D reads (Complaint Form - CSC Form 3), browses,
(CHRMO)                            evaluates and determines the complaints received on a daily
                                   basis. The L&D shall coordinate with the concerned Division to
                                   answer the complaint and shall investigate, if necessary. After
                                   the concern has been addressed or after conduct of
                                   investigation, the L&D shall prepare an Incident Report and
                                   refer it to the Legal Office, for further review. Then the Legal
                                   Office shall forward its findings to the City Mayor, copy
                                   furnished the CHRMO, for appropriate action &/or final
                                   decision.

                                   The L&D shall give the feedback to the clients via email, or
                                   through writing.
